summary: A handsome, proportioned panel over a Phase-1-sized audio engine. Chassis geometry, key counts and colour are on spec (deck 0.5375, aspect 3.0951, 73/43/30 keys all inside the keybed, 5/5 reference colours), but the section fractions still use the superseded constants (piano 0.150 vs 0.085) and four Program controls are clipped off the panel. The decisive finding is audio: a connect() census shows only Oscillator -> Biquad -> Gain -> layer bus -> master -> limiter -> destination, with no Delay, Convolver, WaveShaper or Panner anywhere. With the piano layer disabled the instrument renders exact silence (rms 0.000000) however the Organ and Synth are configured, and every effect at extreme settings leaves the note bit-identical (peak 0.12014346569776535 for reverb, delay, mod1, amp, rotary and all-bypass alike). Phase 3's DSP lives entirely in offline renderOrganProbe/renderSynthProbe/renderProbe functions whose output only feeds an RMS readout, and the tests assert on those plus a hard-coded integrationSnapshot() literal, so four green gates certify a path that does not ship. The panel then reports 'Audio: piano + organ 0.026 + synth Infinity', claiming output that does not exist.

criteria.label: Distinct engine character
evidence: Organ and Synth reach no audio. With piano.layer-a toggled off and Organ layer A enabled, its level raised, B3 model and percussion on, holding key-C4 for 1500 ms through a ScriptProcessor tap on the master path recorded rms 0 and peak 0 over 77824 samples; repeating with the Synth (Analog/Super Saw source, cutoff raised) gave rms 0 over 79872 samples. Re-enabling the piano layer immediately restored rms 0.037640.

AudioNode.prototype.connect census over a full session: 28 edges, all of them Oscillator->BiquadFilter (8), BiquadFilter->Gain (8), Gain->Gain (10), Gain->DynamicsCompressor (1), DynamicsCompressor->AudioDestination (1). One AudioContext, one destination, one oscillator per note and no engine-specific node of any kind. The bundle contains no createDelay, createConvolver, createStereoPanner, createWaveShaper or decodeAudioData.

The only timbral variation is oscillator.type on a single OscillatorNode. Measured harmonic profiles of C4 (DFT of the tapped signal, normalised over 6 harmonics): Grand [0.866,0.003,0.096,0.001,0.034], Upright [0.859,0.005,0.098,...], Digital [0.864,0.006,0.094,...] -- all three are the same triangle; Clav [0.410,0.205,0.135,0.102,0.082] is a sawtooth and Misc [0.652,0.003,0.215,0.002,0.130] a square. artifact/src/stage3System.ts also collapses siblings inside its offline model: synthOsc branches on startsWith, so Multi Saw == Multi Saw 8ve, Super Saw == Super Square and Sync Saw == Sync Square.

criteria.label: Effects & routing integration
evidence: The shared master path is real and measurable: one AudioContext, per-layer Gain buses, masterGain -> DynamicsCompressor -> destination. Master Level is the only panel control that moved rendered audio -- at aria-valuetext '12 percent' the same note measured rms 0.006274 and at '84 percent' rms 0.043913, a 7.00x ratio matching the 0.84/0.12 setting.

No effect reaches the signal. A/B on the same note with the piano engine: reverb on + amount 100% -> rms 0.0439140; delay on + mix 92% + feedback 79% -> 0.0439152; mod1 on + amount 98% (type stepped) -> 0.0439111; amp sim on + drive 100% -> 0.0438374; compressor on + amount 96% -> 0.0432160; rotary on + drive 92% -> 0.0439152; all-effects-bypass -> 0.0439111. Baseline was 0.0439128, and the recorded peak was the identical double 0.12014346569776535 in every one of those runs including all-bypass.

Cause located in source: artifact/src/pianoEngine.ts:408 processEffects and all six applyX() functions operate on Float32Arrays inside renderProbe() only; the live noteOnLayer() at line 518 connects oscillator -> filter -> gain -> layer bus with nothing in between, and updateEffects() only mutates a plain object. Organ/Synth cannot inherit the chain because they never create a node.

criteria.label: Musical quality under load
evidence: Stability is good. Five simultaneous computer keys (a s d f g) gave 5 elements with aria-pressed=true and rms 0.102399 / peak 0.400859, versus 0.0376 for one note, so chords work and no rebuild-per-note-on steals the previous voice; after release the tap measured rms exactly 0. A note held 3.6 s measured rms 0.034745 in the first 600 ms window and 0.034718 in a window starting 3.6 s in (ratio 0.9992), so nothing is a fixed pre-rendered buffer.

No main-thread blocking: driving six real pointer note-ons while sampling requestAnimationFrame gaps gave worst frames of 16.9, 15.6, 14.8, 14.4 and 13.8 ms, i.e. no frame overrun attributable to note-on. Sustain from the space bar held the note after key-up (rms 0.044285) and released it on pedal-up (rms 0). No page errors or console errors in any probe session.

Musical quality is thin rather than unstable: the gain envelope ramps to level*0.58 by 420 ms and then holds flat forever (the 3.6 s test shows 0.08% decay over three seconds), so a 'piano' note behaves like a drawbar organ, and only one engine ever contributes to the load.

criteria.label: Program & state round-trip
evidence: The dirty flag is truthful and the display navigates: editing piano.layer-a-level turned the program OLED from '1.1 Studio Grand' to '1.1 Studio Grand E'; program-3 moved it to '1.3 Vox Split ... 126 BPM' and cleared the E; page-right then program-1 gave '2.1 User Program 9 ... 144 BPM'; Live Mode gave 'LIVE 1 / Live 1'; Store cleared the E again.

Recall restores nothing outside the OLED. On the program change from 1.1 to 1.3 the only panel attribute that changed anywhere on the instrument was the program button's own aria-pressed -- piano.layer-a-level stayed at the edited 'aria-valuetext: 0 percent' instead of returning to the slot's 0.82, and after Store on 2.2, leaving to 2.4 and returning, piano.layer-b-level still read the edited '66 percent'. The piano engine is never updated on program change either, so the sound does not follow the program.

No persistence: a setItem spy recorded zero storage writes for the whole session and the bundle contains no localStorage/sessionStorage/indexedDB reference; after reload the OLED is back to '1.1 Studio Grand' and Transpose 0. Store As exists only as the storeAsProgram() state function with no UI, and the listView flag set by the program dial is never read by App.tsx.

criteria.label: Performance controls & bindings
evidence: Web MIDI genuinely works. Stubbing navigator.requestMIDIAccess, the status strip changed from 'MIDI permission denied or unavailable' to '1 MIDI input connected', a 0x90/60/100 message set key-C4 to aria-pressed=true and started a voice, and 0x80/60/0 cleared it; CC64 is wired to setSustain in source. Computer keyboard covers 17 keys with repeat suppression, and space sustains once focus is cleared (measured above).

Panic is unreachable. changeControl only panics when 'nextValue > 0.5 && controlState[transpose] > 0.5', but transpose is a button whose nextControlValue flips 1 -> 0, so the second press always arrives with nextValue 0. Pressing it twice moved the status readout to 'Transpose 4' then 'Transpose 5' and the status message never left 'Stage 4 piano library ready'; no panic message was ever produced.

Octave Up/Down are mis-wired: layerFromControl('performance.octave-up') returns 'A', so the global button also sets piano layer A octave to +12 while adding +1 to transpose. Intercepting OscillatorNode.frequency.setValueAtTime, key-C4 played 261.6256 Hz before and 622.2540 Hz after three presses of OCTAVE UP -- a 15-semitone jump for a readout of 'Transpose 3'. The Mod Wheel is declared a morph source but moving it to 72% changed no display and no audio; the Pitch Stick is honestly labelled a decorative control.

criteria.label: Cross-system workflows
evidence: Splits are inert and unreachable. program.split fails the 5x5 elementFromPoint test at 1440x900 (all 25 points resolve to .control-deck/.keybed/.piano-key), and a real mouse click at its centre left aria-pressed='false' with the OLED unchanged. There is no control anywhere for the 11 documented split positions or the Off/6/12 crossfades -- applyStage3Control hard-codes points to ['C3','C4','C5'] -- and zoneForMidi/crossfadeGain/layerRouteGain are exported by stage3System.ts but never imported by App.tsx, so note routing never consults a zone.

Scene switching is a label. Clicking Layer Scene II moved the OLED from 'Scene I' to 'Scene II' and set the dirty flag, but the only aria change anywhere on the panel was the scene button's own aria-pressed; no layer enable button moved, the piano engine's layer state was not updated, and the rendered note was unchanged. Organ and Synth layer vectors cannot differ audibly because neither engine reaches audio.

Transpose does reach audio but incorrectly (622.254 Hz for C4 after three Octave Up presses, see bindings), and Panic cannot be triggered from the panel at all, so none of split / scene / transpose / panic behaves correctly across the three engines.

criteria.label: Organ system
evidence: The hardware inventory is complete and drives a typed state model: 9 .control-drawbar elements each with an 8-segment LED ladder, B3/Vox/Farf/Pipe model buttons, percussion, vibrato/chorus (cycling C1-C3/V1-V3), a key click knob and a rotary speed button that steps Slow -> Fast -> Stop with a ramp value. stage3System.ts carries genuinely different harmonic tables per model (B3 [0.5,0.26,1,...], Vox, Farf with its odd-harmonic on/off drawbar quantisation, Pipe).

None of it is audible. Moving organ.drawbar-3 from 'aria-valuetext: 84 percent' to '14 percent' and selecting the Vox model changed only the status readout 'Audio: piano + organ 0.125' -> '0.077' -> '0.026', which is the RMS of the offline renderOrganProbe() Float32Array printed into a text span; a held key-C4 with the piano layer off measured rms 0 throughout. Rotary slow/fast/stop and drive likewise leave the rendered signal bit-identical.
The LED ladders do not track the drawbars: App.tsx renders <LedLadder value={(9 - index) / 10} />, a constant per slot, so the level graph is decorative regardless of drawbar position.

criteria.label: Synth system
evidence: The panel and its OLED are live and complete on paper: source-category buttons, an oscillator selector that cycles all 14 declared waveforms, Osc Ctrl, cutoff/resonance, a filter-type button stepping LP12/LP24/HP/BP, ADSR knobs, LFO rate, arp rate/run and Mono. Stepping osc-select twice and filter-type once moved the synth OLED from 'FM-H / LP24 / FM 2-op (algorithm A)' to 'Pure / HP / Triangle'.

Zero audio: with the synth layer enabled, level raised and cutoff opened, holding key-C4 while the piano layer was off measured rms 0 over 79872 samples on the master tap. The synth 'engine' is renderSynthProbe(), an offline Float32Array generator whose only consumer is the RMS text in the status strip.

The offline model is also unsound. At the default program the status strip read 'Audio: piano + organ 0.125 + synth Infinity' -- the probe's own RMS overflows at startup. Multi Saw / Multi Saw 8ve, Super Saw / Super Square and Sync Saw / Sync Square are rendered by the same startsWith branch, unison is not settable from any panel control, and arpeggiatorSteps() is absent from build/assets/index-0U21Kq2U.js because App.tsx never imports it -- the arpeggiator sequencing logic exists only for the test file.

criteria.label: Layers, splits, scenes & morphs
evidence: Piano layers are real: enabling Layer B and focusing it added a second voice (harmonic profile of C4 shifted from the pure triangle [0.866,0.003,0.096,...] to [0.824,0.024,0.090,0.012,0.042] with a sawtooth component at layer B's level), disabling Layer A produced exact silence, and layer level/focus reach the engine's per-layer Gain buses.

Splits, scenes and morphs are all inert (see crossSystemWorkflow): the split button is unreachable, scene switching changes only OLED text with no layer or audio change, and moving the Mod Wheel to 72% interpolated synth.A.filter.cutoff inside the working snapshot with no indicator, no display change and no audio consequence.

The three morph assign buttons are not merely inert but off the panel: program.morph-wheel, program.morph-pedal and program.morph-aftertouch lay out at y=446.7-493.4 while the Program section box ends at y=448.45 with overflow:hidden, so all 25 grid points of each resolve to the keybed. Organ A/B and Synth A/B/C layer routing exists only in the state model.

criteria.label: Programs & Live Mode
evidence: Structure is correct and navigable: 32 slots over 4 pages plus 8 Live slots, an 8-button pad, page left/right, a program dial, Store, and a Live Mode toggle. Measured transitions: '1.1 Studio Grand' -> '1.3 Vox Split' -> page right '2.3' -> '2.1 User Program 9' -> 'LIVE 1 / Live 1' and back, with the dirty 'E' appearing on edit and clearing on both program change and Store, and the status strip mirroring 'Program 2.1' / 'Program Live 1'.

Behaviour is materially incomplete: recall restores no control position and does not touch the audio engine (piano.layer-b-level still read '66 percent' after leaving and returning to slot 2.2), nothing persists (zero storage writes; reload returns to 1.1), the numeric list view flag set by the program dial is never rendered, Store As has no UI (declared as a state-path-only in evidence/stage3-visual-audit.md), and there is no undo/cancel control on the panel.

criteria.label: Chassis, silhouette & geometry

measurements.label: Worst of the six section-fraction deviations

evidence: Measured on the served build at 1440x900 (page loaded assets/index-0U21Kq2U.js and assets/index-vPnzszbG.css, matching build/assets): .instrument-shell 1353.59 x 437.33 px at x=43.20, y=219.14 -> widthFraction 0.94000 (inside [0.88,0.97]) and aspectRatio 3.09514 (target 3.0951). Top rail 26.11 + deck 208.95 = 235.06 / 437.33 = deckFraction 0.53750; keybed 178.48 + bottom rail 21.77 = 200.25 / 437.33 = keybedFraction 0.45789. Both inside the 0.025 band, and the document is exactly 1440x900 with no scroll.

Six section fractions from the rendered [data-section-id] boxes, normalised by the sum of section widths: performance 0.13004 (spec 0.14), organ 0.20994 (0.20), piano 0.15003 (0.085), program 0.09010 (0.125), synth 0.20994 (0.25), effects 0.20994 (0.20). Worst deviation is the Piano section at 0.06503; normalising by the deck span instead gives 0.06234. Reported 0.0650, which is 5.4x the 0.012 tolerance.

The cause is artifact/src/hardware.ts:30-37, which hard-codes the superseded coarse fractions rather than the corrected values in inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.visual.json; the rendered widths reproduce those constants to within 0.0001, so the deviation is structural rather than a rounding artefact.

criteria.label: Hardware inventory & placement

measurements.label: Required section landmarks rendered in their own section
Controls a pointer can actually operate

evidence: Landmark census over the 33 sectionLandmarks entries: performance 4/5 (Master Level knob, pitch stick, mod wheel and 'nord stage 4' branding all render on exposed red chassis with no inset plate; the Rotary Speaker block is absent from this band -- its controls exist only inside the Layer Effects plate, whereas inputs/reference/nord-stage-4-73.jpg shows a dedicated ROTARY SPEAKER plate on the red chassis under Master Level, and the spec note says to score placement against the photograph). organ 4/4 (nine .control-drawbar elements, nine 8-segment LED ladders, four model switches, percussion). piano 5/5. synth 6/6. effects 6/6. program 6/7: the three morph assign buttons lay out at y 446.7-493.4 while their section box ends at y=448.45, so none of them is rendered inside its own section.

Reachability by the 5x5 document.elementFromPoint grid at 1440x900 with the page unscrolled (scrollY 0, document height exactly 900): 128 of 132 [data-control-id] elements resolved to themselves or a descendant at one or more grid points. The four failures are program.split, program.morph-wheel, program.morph-pedal and program.morph-aftertouch, whose every grid point resolves to .control-deck, .keybed or a .piano-key because .section is overflow:hidden and the 3-column program grid needs ~98% of the section height against ~67% available. All 73 keys are reachable. (piano.electric passes at 15/25 points and so counts as reachable, but its centre and right 60% are covered by the piano.model-select knob -- reported separately as an issue rather than charged here.)

Forbidden elements present: 2. (1) synth 'uniform repeated knob matrix' -- the entire synth section is one grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr) matrix of identically sized knobs and buttons on a uniform pitch with no oscillator/filter/envelope grouping. (2) effects 'single undifferentiated control grid' -- all 36 Layer Effects controls sit in one repeat(6,1fr) grid with no boundary between Mod 1, Mod 2, Delay, Amp/EQ, Compressor and Reverb. Not counted: the performance band has neither a dark inset plate nor an OLED, piano has no drawbar bank or wide OLED, program has exactly one primary display, and the organ keeps a genuinely differentiated nine-drawbar bank.

criteria.label: Keybed fidelity

measurements.label: Keys whose box falls inside the keybed

evidence: 73 .piano-key elements at 1440x900: 43 white and 30 black, MIDI 28 (E1) through 100 (E7), matching the Stage 4 73 variant exactly. All 73 key boxes fall inside the .keybed rect (x 87.45-1336.33, y 455.20-633.69) with zero outside, and all 73 are pointer-reachable on the 5x5 elementFromPoint grid.

Mean white key 27.72 x 166.11 px, mean black key 18.58 x 106.42 px: black/white height ratio 0.6407 (reported; target 0.61 +/-0.03, so 0.0007 outside the band) and black/white width ratio 0.6702. Measured against the keybed box instead, the black-key height is 0.5963.

Black-key horizontal placement is wrong by one white key: key-Fs1 centres at x=116.48 while F1 spans 118.89-146.61 and E1 spans 89.94-117.66, key-Gs1 centres at 145.52 (the F/G boundary) and key-Cs2 at 232.66 (the A/B boundary), because --black-left is whiteIndex/43 with whiteIndex being the preceding white key. Every accidental therefore sits a whole key left of its position in the reference photograph.

criteria.label: Chassis & plate colour fidelity
evidence: A screenshot of the instrument bounding box at 1440x900 was decoded onto a canvas in-page and every rendered surface holding at least 89 px was converted to CIE Lab. Nearest-surface CIE76 deltaE against the spec referenceColors: chassisMid #851a25 -> rgb(134,25,37) deltaE 0.60; chassisDark #5a0c13 -> rgb(89,17,23) deltaE 2.74; panelBlueGray #3c424d -> rgb(60,67,77) deltaE 0.75; keyBlack #0b0b0b -> rgb(8,9,9) deltaE 0.66; keyWhite #dcdcdc -> rgb(217,218,218) deltaE 0.92.

All five are inside deltaE 12, so 5 of 5 match. The matches come from real surfaces rather than antialiasing: the chassis is a horizontal gradient (#6c1c24 -> #9c2f3b -> #5d171e) with darker cheek blocks at 3.1% each side, the section plates are the #444b55 -> #242a32 blue-grey inset with a red perimeter, and the keybed sits on #090909.

criteria.label: Materials, legends & displays
evidence: Materials and caps are convincing at the rendered size: knobs are radial-gradient caps with a rotating indicator line driven by transform:rotate(calc(-135deg + var(--value)*270deg)), faders and drawbars carry real light metal caps that slide with the value, the nine drawbars each sit under an 8-segment green LED ladder, buttons light red with a glow when latched, and both OLEDs are teal-on-dark monospace with an inset shadow. Colour fidelity measures 5/5 within deltaE 12.

Legends fail at the rendered size. .control-label is clamp(4px, 0.34vw, 7px) with nowrap and ellipsis, so at 1440x900 all nine drawbar legends read 'ORGAN...' identically and the piano/program sections read 'PIANO LAYER A...', 'PIANO B OCTAV...', 'PROGRAM...'; the screenshot at scratch/probe-p3-deck-zoom.png shows most of the deck as truncated fragments. Drawbars carry no 16'/5 1/3'/8' footage marks, knobs have no scales or tick legends, and the piano.model-select knob physically covers the Electric type button (its centre resolves to piano.model-select).

criteria.label: Panel state & displays
evidence: Direct manipulation is well reflected: every control exposes aria-valuenow/aria-valuetext or aria-pressed and updates on interaction (master-level stepped 0.72 -> 0.84 -> 0.96 -> 0.12 with matching knob rotation), the program OLED shows page.slot, program name, a truthful dirty 'E', scene, split points and BPM and updates on every navigation, and the synth OLED tracks category/filter/waveform/LFO/arp ('FM-H / LP24 / FM 2-op' -> 'Pure / HP / Triangle' after stepping osc-select and filter-type).

But the panel does not show what the instrument is doing. Loading a different program changed no control position anywhere (piano.layer-a-level stayed at the edited 0% instead of the slot's 82%); switching Layer Scene II changed no layer enable indicator; moving the Mod Wheel to 72% produced no morph indicator; the drawbar LED ladders are the constant (9-index)/10 and never follow their drawbars; and the strip reports 'Audio: piano + organ 0.125 + synth Infinity' at startup -- a display of an offline probe RMS for engines that emit nothing, showing Infinity until a synth control is touched.

criteria.label: Narrow-viewport retention
evidence: At 390x844 the instrument stays whole and recognisable: the shell measures 374.39 x 120.95 px (widthFraction 0.960, aspect 3.0953), document scrollWidth is exactly 390 with no horizontal overflow and scrollHeight exactly 844, all 73 keys render and all 73 remain inside the keybed horizontally, and the red chassis, six plates, both OLEDs and the drawbar bank are all still identifiable in scratch/probe-p3-narrow.png.

Usability collapses though: only 109 of 132 controls pass the 5x5 elementFromPoint test (23 unreachable, up from 4 at desktop), the narrowest control is 5.83 px wide, the label font is pinned to 3.4px so no legend is readable, and the brand block overflows its section. The instrument also occupies only the middle 14% of the viewport height, with the remainder empty.

issues.title: Organ and Synth engines produce no audio at all
issues.detail: Phase 3's two new engines never create an audio node. With the piano layer disabled, holding key-C4 for 1500 ms with the Organ enabled (level raised, B3, percussion on) recorded rms 0 / peak 0 across 77824 samples on a tap patched onto AudioNode.prototype.connect at the destination; the same test with the Synth (Analog source, cutoff opened) recorded rms 0 across 79872 samples. The full-session connect census contains only Oscillator->Biquad->Gain->bus->master->limiter->destination edges. renderOrganProbe() and renderSynthProbe() in artifact/src/stage3System.ts are pure functions returning Float32Arrays that are consumed exclusively by rms() calls printed into a status <span>.

issues.title: Every effect unit is disconnected from the live signal path
issues.detail: Mod 1, Mod 2, Delay, Amp Sim/EQ, Compressor, Reverb and Rotary all leave the rendered signal unchanged. Driven to extremes one at a time on the same note, the tapped peak was the identical double 0.12014346569776535 for reverb (mix 100%), delay (mix 92%, feedback 79%), mod1 (amount 98%), amp (drive 100%), rotary (drive 92%) and for all-effects-bypass; rms varied only in the 5th decimal (0.043911-0.043915). The bundle contains no DelayNode, ConvolverNode, WaveShaperNode or StereoPannerNode. All effect DSP lives in processEffects() inside pianoEngine.ts renderProbe(), which is never connected to anything.

issues.title: The panel reports audio output for engines that are silent
issues.detail: The status strip renders 'Audio: piano + organ 0.026 + synth 0.000' from the RMS of the offline probe arrays, and the screen-reader block states 'Piano, Organ, Synth, Layer Effects, Programs, Live slots, splits, scenes, morphs, master clock, transpose, and Panic are functional in Phase 3.' Measured, the Organ and Synth emit nothing, splits/scenes/morphs change no audio or panel state, and Panic cannot be triggered. Every organ and synth control is also given the accessible name suffix 'control' rather than 'decorative control'. This is the honesty contract's fake-success case, even though evidence/stage3-visual-audit.md does separately admit 'the inherited live Web Audio oscillator path remains piano-focused'.

issues.title: The gate-passing test suite asserts on offline stand-ins, not the shipped path
issues.detail: src/App.test.tsx exercises Phase 3 through renderOrganProbe/renderSynthProbe/engine.renderProbe against a FakeAudioContext, and its integration test asserts on integrationSnapshot(), a function in stage3System.ts that returns the hard-coded literal { audioContextCount: 1, destinationCount: 1, engines: ['Piano','Organ','Synth'], masterPath: [...] }. Nothing verifies the real graph. integrationSnapshot and arpeggiatorSteps are tree-shaken out of build/assets/index-0U21Kq2U.js entirely, so test/typecheck/lint/build are all green over code that does not ship.

issues.title: Four Program controls are clipped off the panel and cannot be reached
issues.detail: program.split, program.morph-wheel, program.morph-pedal and program.morph-aftertouch lay out at y 446.7-493.4 while the Program section box ends at y 448.45 with overflow:hidden. All 25 elementFromPoint probes on each resolve to .control-deck, .keybed or a .piano-key, and a real mouse click at the Split button's centre left aria-pressed='false'. Cause: .grid-program packs 19 controls into 3 columns at 13% row height (~98% of section height) with only ~67% available after the title and OLED, in a section the layout makes only 102 px wide.

issues.title: Section widths use the superseded coarse fractions
issues.detail: artifact/src/hardware.ts:30-37 hard-codes performance 0.13, organ 0.21, piano 0.15, program 0.09, synth 0.21, effects 0.21, and the rendered widths reproduce those to within 0.0001 (measured 0.13004 / 0.20994 / 0.15003 / 0.09010 / 0.20994 / 0.20994). The corrected spec values are 0.14 / 0.20 / 0.085 / 0.125 / 0.25 / 0.20, so the Piano section is 0.065 too wide -- 5.4x the 0.012 tolerance -- and the Program and Synth sections are 0.035 and 0.040 too narrow. This is why the Program section is too cramped to hold its own controls.

issues.title: Every black key is displaced one white key to the left
issues.detail: styles.css positions black keys at left:calc(var(--black-left) - 100%/43*0.32) where --black-left is whiteIndex/43, and hardware.ts assigns each black key the index of the PRECEDING white key. Measured: key-Fs1 centres at x=116.48 while F1 spans 118.89-146.61 and E1 spans 89.94-117.66, so F# sits on the E/F boundary; key-Gs1 centres at 145.52 (F/G boundary) and key-Cs2 at 232.66 (A/B boundary). The 2-and-3 grouping therefore does not align with the reference photograph, though all 73 keys remain inside the keybed.

issues.title: Program recall updates the display but not the instrument
issues.detail: Changing programs replaces stage3.working but never writes back to controlState or to the piano engine. After editing piano.layer-a-level to 0% and loading program 1.3, the control still read '0 percent' instead of the slot's 0.82, and the only panel attribute that changed anywhere was the program button's aria-pressed. Storing to slot 2.2, navigating to 2.4 and returning left piano.layer-b-level at the edited 66%. There is also no persistence layer at all (zero setItem calls, no localStorage in the bundle), so a reload returns to 1.1 Studio Grand.

issues.title: Panic is unreachable and Octave Up/Down transposes by 13 semitones
issues.detail: The panic guard in App.tsx requires nextValue > 0.5 while the previous transpose value is also > 0.5, but a button's next value flips 1 -> 0, so the condition is never satisfiable; pressing Transpose repeatedly only walked the readout to 'Transpose 4' and 'Transpose 5' with no panic message. Separately, layerFromControl('performance.octave-up') returns 'A', so the global octave buttons also set piano layer A's octave to +12: intercepting frequency.setValueAtTime, key-C4 played 261.6256 Hz before and 622.2540 Hz after three presses (15 semitones for a readout of 3).

issues.title: The Piano Electric type button is covered by the Model Select knob
issues.detail: The .control-face of a knob is min(88%, 2.2vw) wide and overflows its grid cell, so piano.model-select covers the right 60% of piano.electric (10 of 25 grid points, including the exact centre, resolve to piano.model-select). A centre click therefore steps the model encoder instead: measured across a full sweep of the six type buttons, Upright/Clav/Digital/Misc/Grand all latched aria-pressed=true and changed the oscillator waveform, while two attempts at Electric left aria-pressed='false' and the waveform unchanged. Electric is effectively unselectable.

issues.title: The published index.html is a fragment, so the page renders in quirks mode
issues.detail:
build/index.html contains only the script tag, stylesheet link and
-- no doctype, html, head, charset or title. Chromium reports document.compatMode 'BackCompat' and document.doctype null when serving these exact bits, and the browser tab has no title. All measurements in this assessment were taken against that quirks-mode rendering.

issues.title: Drawbar LED ladders are hard-coded and the synth readout shows Infinity
issues.detail: App.tsx renders <LedLadder value={(9 - index) / 10} />, a constant per drawbar slot, so the organ level graph never follows the drawbar it sits above -- moving organ.drawbar-3 from 84% to 14% leaves its ladder unchanged. At the default program the status strip reads 'Audio: piano + organ 0.125 + synth Infinity'; the synth probe's RMS overflows until a synth control is touched, after which it settles to values like 0.028.

issues.title: Silkscreen legends are truncated to illegibility at the rendered size
issues.detail: .control-label is clamp(4px, 0.34vw, 7px) with white-space:nowrap and text-overflow:ellipsis, so at 1440x900 most legends render as fragments: all nine drawbars read 'ORGAN...', and the piano and program sections read 'PIANO LAYER A...', 'PIANO B OCTAV...', 'PROGRAM...'. At 390x844 the label font is forced to 3.4px.
